profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Scaling Golang microservices on AWS with Kubernetes, DevOps & CI/CD Automation.
profile.summary:
Passionate Senior Software Engineer specializing in building scalable backend systems, advancing DevOps automation, and developing optimized Golang microservices. With expertise in managing Kubernetes infrastructures on AWS and architecting robust APIs, I excel at streamlining CI/CD pipelines, modernizing legacy systems, and enhancing operational reliability to deliver high-performance, customer-centric software solutions.

Technical Proficiency:
- Languages & Frameworks: Golang, gRPC, GraphQL, NodeJS, JavaScript, Python, Bash, PHP, Lua, Linux
- Tools & Platforms: Terraform, Helm, OCR

Cloud & DevOps:
- AWS (S3, EC2, EKS, RDS, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, Lambda), Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker
- CI/CD & Automation: Github Actions, Jenkins
- Databases & Systems: Aerospike DB, Elasticsearch, MySQL, Redis, Nginx
